latin: Intellectus agens nihil est aliud quam pars animae quae sursum manet et non cadit.
translation: The agent intellect is nothing other than the part of the soul that remains above and does not fall.
translation_note: No English translation is given for this thesis in Farmer's edition, whose note there (farmer1998:15316) gives a close paraphrase of the same thesis; translated directly from the Latin.
